verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm an llms.txt at docs.nvidia.com that indexes NVIDIA's documentation for AI user agents (HTTP 200). They also confirm the DGX B200 user guide is served as clean markdown via a .html.md variant, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs for this product. Missing for 10: confirmation that the site-wide llms.txt collection links B200-specific content, no machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI paths 404), and no independent or hands-on reports of agents using these docs.
